title: Shop role-play sheet
subject: PSHE
source: Written for pshe/y4 lesson 6 (Shop role-play sheet (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 6: Paying for goods. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

model.title: A sandwich costs £2.35. You pay with £5. Change?

panels.title: Receipts
points: Show what was bought and the price

blocks.h: Shop role play: find the change

blocks.text: Count up from the price to the money you pay with.

blocks.answers: Change: Juice 55p; Book £1.80; Banana 15p; Prayer mat £3.25; Lunchbox 40p; Football £7.70.

keywords.def: a card that takes money straight from a bank account
money given back when you pay too much
a paper or digital record of what was bought

questions.q: Core: Shop role-play sheet: find the change for six purchases (pupil PDF).
Extend: A receipt says £4.50 but the shelf said £3.50. What should you do?
questions.a: Politely ask the shop to check: you may have been overcharged £1.

questions.q: Stretch: Explain why paying by card can make it easier to overspend.
questions.a: You do not see money leave, so it is easy to lose track.

questions.q: You pay £1 for an 85p drink. Change?
A receipt is... A) a type of coin B) a record of what was bought C) a bank
questions.a: B) a record of what was bought
options: A record of what was bought

questions.q: Big question: how does a grown-up know what a card payment cost?
questions.a: The receipt and the bank account.
